title: Origin story: Tangaroa
description: Tangaroa is the great god of the sea across Polynesia, father of fish and patron of voyagers. In some traditions he is the supreme creator, whose children became the islands' first peoples. Navigators pray to him before crossing the open ocean, and his moods are the sea's moods.

title: Ability profile: Tangaroa
description: Ranked abilities: Sea command — rank 100/100; Navigation blessing — rank 97/100; Patience — rank 96/100; Creation — rank 95/100; Majesty — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Tangaroa
description: Powers: The ocean itself as his body; Fish beyond counting as his children; The voyaging canoe's safe passage.

title: Stamina feats: Tangaroa
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Has held the sea since creation; Endures every storm unchanged.

title: Crossover notes: Tangaroa
description: Tangaroa crosses naturally with: the ocean, fish, voyaging, creation.

title: Cultural impact: Tangaroa
description: The Pacific's father; the sea as god.
